parsed.rationale: All eight members are unnamed extensions (name is empty string) on CGImage scattered across three packages (Artwork, AppServices, app:iOS) and multiple files including test files and production source. The cluster_id signals a name-collision query, but because the extensions carry no name and no fields_or_signature, the structural pipeline has only detected that multiple files extend the same Foundation/UIKit type (CGImage). Extensions on a system type in different packages for different domain purposes (artwork fetching, now-playing info center management) are idiomatic Swift and intentional — there is no shared logic to consolidate without evidence of duplicated members. The structural_evidence block confirms this: jaccard, shared_field_count, shared_ancestor, and differing_slots are all null, meaning no content overlap was measured.
